files.title: mod
files.description: The mod's identity. The folder name is the mod's id.
files.preamble: The mod's identity. The folder name ({mod_id}) is the mod's id.

sections.name: mod
sections.title: Mod

parameters.label: Mod name
parameters.help: Name shown for this mod in the Mods list.

parameters.label: Version
parameters.help: Your version string, e.g. 1.0. Raise it when you release an update.

parameters.label: Author
parameters.help: Your name or handle.

parameters.label: Description
parameters.help: Short blurb about the mod. Also used as the default dealer text.

parameters.label: Priority
parameters.comment: higher wins when two mods provide the same file or car label
parameters.help: Higher wins when two mods provide the same file or car label.

sections.description: The mod’s identity. The folder name is the mod’s id.

files.title: maker
files.description: Only needed for a maker the disc doesn't have. Every car whose [car] maker matches this maker's name is sold at its dealer.
files.preamble:
A maker the disc doesn't have gets a dealer of its own (docs/MODDING.md
"Dealers and makers"). Every car whose [car] maker matches `name` is sold here.

sections.name: maker
sections.title: Maker
sections.footer_notes: icon, background and logo are optional: without them the dealer shows its name.

parameters.label: Maker name
parameters.help: Must match the car’s Maker field. Taken automatically from the Car tab.

parameters.label: Region
parameters.help: Dealer region: jp, us, gr, fr, it, uk, bel or aus.

parameters.label: Dealer text
parameters.help: Scrolling text on the region / dealer page. Defaults to the mod description.

parameters.label: Icon (strip)
parameters.help: 51×27 strip button. Browse… copies into images/. Optional — without it the name is shown.

parameters.label: Background
parameters.help: 640×448 dealer backdrop. Browse… copies into images/. Optional.

parameters.label: Logo
parameters.help: 475×190 logo (transparent). Browse… copies into images/. Optional — without it the name is drawn in the menu font.

sections.description: Only needed for a maker the disc does not have. Cars with this maker name are sold here.

files.title: car
files.description: The car, defined as data. Anything you leave blank is borrowed from the donor.

sections.name: car
sections.title: Car

parameters.label: Label (id)
parameters.comment: unique id (a-z, 0-9, _). Garage, saves and replays use it: never change it once shared
parameters.help: Unique id used by the garage, saves and replays. a-z, 0-9, _ only. Never change it once shared — the .ini is named after it.

parameters.label: Display name
parameters.help: Name shown after the maker (e.g. Maker = Daihatsu, Name = Dumbo → “Daihatsu Dumbo”).

parameters.label: Maker
parameters.help: Disc maker to sell under, or a new name (then keep the maker file). Must match the maker file’s name.

parameters.label: Model year
parameters.help: Year of the car, e.g. 1989.

parameters.label: Dealer price
parameters.help: Price in credits at the dealer.

parameters.label: Category
parameters.help: production = road car. race / rally use other bodies and rules.

parameters.label: Donor car
parameters.comment:
the donor lends suspension geometry, steering, tyre compounds,
brakes, aids and the shop's upgrade parts.
parameters.help: Disc car that lends suspension, steering, tyres, brakes, aids and upgrade parts. Use Browse to search.

sections.description: Identity of the car. Blank fields in other sections are borrowed from the donor.

sections.name: body
sections.title: Body
sections.lead_notes: Measured from the model: ground at y = 0, centred on the wheelbase midpoint.

parameters.label: Curb weight
parameters.comment: curb weight (the game adds 120 kg of driver)
parameters.help: Weight in kg before the driver. The game adds 120 kg for the driver.

parameters.label: Front weight %
parameters.help: Share of weight on the front axle (50 = even). Affects handling balance.

parameters.label: Length
parameters.help: Overall length in mm. Model tools can measure this from the .glb.

parameters.label: Width
parameters.help: Overall width in mm, without mirrors. Model tools can measure this.

parameters.label: Height
parameters.help: Overall height in mm. Model tools can measure this.

parameters.label: Wheelbase
parameters.comment: between the wheel centres of the model
parameters.help: Distance between front and rear wheel centres, in mm.

parameters.label: Front track
parameters.comment: centre to centre of the modelled tyres
parameters.help: Distance between left and right front wheel centres, in mm.

parameters.label: Rear track
parameters.help: Distance between left and right rear wheel centres, in mm.

parameters.label: Drag (Cd)
parameters.help: Drag coefficient. Lower = less air resistance. Typical road cars ~0.30–0.40.

parameters.label: Frontal area
parameters.help: Front-on area in m². Rough guide: 0.82 × width(m) × height(m).

parameters.label: Ride height
parameters.help: Leave blank to use the donor’s ride height.

sections.description: Size and weight. Model tools can fill length, width, height, wheelbase and tracks from the .glb.

sections.name: powertrain
sections.title: Powertrain

parameters.label: Powertrain type
parameters.help: engine for ICE, or electric for an EV (adds motor/regen behaviour).

parameters.label: Torque curve
parameters.title: Engine torque curve
parameters.note_above: Torque (N*m) at the crank; peak power = torque x rpm / 9549.
parameters.help: rpm:Nm pairs, up to 16 points.

parameters.label: Rev limiter
parameters.help: Engine will not rev past this (rpm). Align the torque curve to end here.

parameters.label: Idle rpm
parameters.help: Idle speed in rpm.

parameters.label: Output %
parameters.comment:
GT3's hidden output factor (disc cars: mostly 100-120),
fitted with `gt3tool modcar` to the [reference] 0-60 and quarter mile
parameters.help: Hidden GT3 power scale (disc cars mostly 100–120). Tune with gt3tool modcar against [reference].

parameters.label: Engine layout
parameters.help: e.g. I4, V6, V12, H4. Shown in the car database.

parameters.label: Aspiration
parameters.help: NA = naturally aspirated, TURBO = turbocharged.

parameters.label: Displacement
parameters.help: Engine size, e.g. 1600cc.

parameters.label: Sound id
parameters.help: Numeric engine sound bank id (sound/engine/NNNNN on the disc). Leave blank to use the donor's sound. Browse… picks a disc car and fills in that car's sound bank id (not the car label).

sections.description: Engine (or motor). Edit the torque curve on the Torque curve tab.

sections.name: drivetrain
sections.title: Drivetrain

parameters.label: Drive layout
parameters.help: FF front, FR front-engine RWD, MR mid-engine RWD, RR rear-engine RWD, 4WD.

parameters.label: Gear ratios
parameters.help: Space-separated ratios, 1st gear first (largest number). Edit on the Gearbox tab too.

parameters.label: Final drive
parameters.help: Final drive ratio, e.g. 4.10. Higher = more acceleration, lower top speed.

parameters.label: Reverse ratio
parameters.help: Reverse gear ratio.

sections.description: Drive layout and gearing. The Gearbox tab edits the same ratios with charts.

sections.name: tires
sections.title: Tyres

parameters.label: Front tyre
parameters.help: Size like 205/55R16. Wheels are drawn from this.

parameters.label: Rear tyre
parameters.help: Same format as the front, e.g. 225/45R17.

parameters.label: Grip %
parameters.help: Street-compound grip scale. Fit to [reference] skidpad with gt3tool modcar.

sections.description: Tyre sizes drive the on-screen wheels and rolling radius (used for speed charts).

sections.name: model
sections.title: Model

parameters.label: Model file
parameters.comment: our own body: the wheels come from the engine
parameters.help: Path to your .glb body under the mod, e.g. models/my_car.glb.

parameters.label: Wheel (rim id)
parameters.comment: a disc rim (browse them with gt3r --browse wheel/)
parameters.help: Disc rim id, e.g. ma1031. Browse with gt3r --browse wheel/.

parameters.label: Body lower (mm)
parameters.comment: fine-tune the body's height over the wheels if the arches look off
parameters.help: Fine-tune how far the body sits over the wheels if the arches look off.

sections.description: 3D body and rim. Paths are under the mod folder.

sections.name: dealer
sections.title: Dealer

parameters.label: For sale
parameters.help: If yes, the car can be bought at its maker’s dealer for the price above.

parameters.label: Dealer text
parameters.help: Scrolling text on the dealer page. Defaults to the mod description.

parameters.label: Picture
parameters.comment: 640x448, rendered with the game's car viewer (README.md "Pictures")
parameters.help: 640×448 dealer photo. Browse… copies into images/.

parameters.label: Thumbnail
parameters.comment: 51x27: the dealer's strip button and the arcade picker's icon
parameters.help: 51×27 strip button and arcade icon. Browse… copies into images/.

parameters.label: Logo
parameters.help: Optional 256×80 name art. Without it the menu font is used.

sections.description: How the car appears at the dealer: text, photo and strip icon.

sections.name: arcade
sections.title: Arcade

parameters.label: Arcade class
parameters.comment: auto (by power-to-weight, as GT3 ranks garage cars), c, b, a, s, dirt or none
parameters.help: auto = rank by power-to-weight. Or force c / b / a / s / dirt / none.

parameters.label: Race variant
parameters.comment: the class's race for stronger (0) or weaker (1) cars
parameters.help: Which race in that class: auto, or 0 (stronger) / 1 (weaker).

parameters.label: Unlock level
parameters.help: Arcade unlock level. 0 = available from the start.

sections.description: Where the car sits in Arcade mode.

sections.name: reference
sections.title: Reference targets
sections.lead_notes:
Targets for the car's class (e.g. magazine tests).
Only `gt3tool modcar` reads these: it prints its own results next to them.

parameters.label: 0–60 mph (s)
parameters.help: Target 0–60 mph time in seconds (magazine tests). Only gt3tool modcar reads this.

parameters.label: ¼ mile (s)
parameters.help: Target quarter-mile time in seconds.

parameters.label: Top speed (km/h)
parameters.help: Target top speed in km/h.

parameters.label: Skidpad (g)
parameters.help: Target cornering grip on a skidpad, in g.

sections.description: Real-world targets for tuning. Only gt3tool modcar compares against these.
